description: This file defines the AdoNetGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder class, which implements the IProviderBuilder interface to configure ADO.NET based grain directory providers within Orleans SiloBuilder. It includes logic to set connection strings and invariants based on configuration sections.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IProviderBuilder for configuring ADO.NET grain directory providers in Orleans.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder with ADO.NET grain directory settings based on the provided configuration section.
